title: Unified Admin shell
summary: Admin and Super Admin are one Admin area: a single primary nav item, a permission-gated page submenu, Super Admin diagnostics on the shared Overview when entitled, and legacy /superadmin URLs that redirect into Admin.
changes: Show one primary Admin link when the signed-in user can open any Admin child; hide Admin entirely for everyone else.
Merge Overview, Public users, Staff, Access, Plugins, and Maintenance into one permission-gated Admin page submenu.
Render Super Admin technical KPIs, charts, and operational context on the same /admin Overview when the user has superadmin.access.
Redirect legacy /superadmin (and remaining children) into Admin equivalents while keeping destination authorization.
Cover public, staff, administrator, and Super Admin navigation, fail-closed URLs, and the redirect map with PHPUnit feature tests.
version_rationale: Minor release opening the v0.35.x line: unifies the Admin shell as a new capability without changing action permission gates.
validation: PHPUnit AdminShellNavigationTest, AdminAnalyticsDashboardTest, AuthorizationAccessMatrixTest, AdminAccessWorkspaceTest, and LocalQaAuthTest pass.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
composer pre-pr-verify (or equivalent local verify) on the PR branch before merge.
known_limitations: Per-plugin settings registry and Recruitment settings pages ship in a later 0.35.x patch.
Action middleware and permission gates are unchanged; only chrome and Overview composition were unified.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version to restore separate Admin and Super Admin primary navigation and the Super Admin overview page.
provenance: Implements issues #251, #250, and #252 via pull request #262 (shell half of #254).
